accepted_deliverable_row.Name: Capability catalog and read-basis contract
accepted_deliverable_row.Description: Define one catalog of meaningful reads/operations and their fields, availability and basis so App, human and embedded consumers share operation meaning. Interfaces: PKG-02 tool requirements consume this contract; DEL-03-02 consumes basis and operation identities; PKG-04 supplies adopted operation-policy classes; host owner supplies actual tables/diagnostics. Verification: Representative reads and unavailable operations agree in result, standing, reason and basis across contracts; generated versus hand-built surfaces are explicit. Automatic extension is not inferred.
accepted_deliverable_row.ResponsibleParty: App/shared capability-contract owner; host owner owns catalog implementation
accepted_deliverable_row.AnticipatedArtifacts: CONFIG: catalog and read-basis schemas;DOC: generated-surface and adapter-responsibility map;TEST: availability/read-standing/basis contract fixtures
accepted_deliverable_row.ContextEnvelopeNotes: A schema and semantic fixture context, not implementation of every host operation. Its many atomic rows are fields/invariants of one coherent catalog result.
accepted_deliverable_row.PhaseHint: Nonbinding: agree the affected operation/receiving contract before its dependent implementation and joined witness.

accepted_scope_rows.ScopeItemStatement: Define semantic parity between human and agent across meaningful reads, operations, validation, results and recovery, subject to separately identified human acts.
Define host reads and changes once in a capability catalog covering each operation a person can perform.
Require the human interface, embedded agent and external agent to use the same capability catalog.
Catalog read operations return the same tables, results and diagnostics, with the same standing, available to the person.
Identify the surfaces generated from the catalog and the responsibilities each adapter still implements.
Catalog entries carry stable identity and version.
Catalog entries state purpose readable by person and agent.
Catalog entries declare preconditions and unavailable reasons.
Catalog entries declare result schemas including standing.
Catalog entries identify operation human-act/autonomy classes, with unresolved reserved-list policy kept explicit.
Generate or check the human, embedded-agent and external interfaces against the catalog while keeping the automatic-extension promise separately qualified.
Give unavailable human and agent operations the same availability result and reason.
Every catalog read returns workspace identity, generation, model revision and canonical content hash as its basis.
Each later action cites the basis it relied upon.
Read results expose current/historical status, passed checks and known limitations without stronger agent claims.
